original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Fresh unchanged native legality and 5/9/11-stage all-column/positive-envelope replay of both PR1868 absorbed words and their exact PR1062/1188 parents, independently rebuilding the three D/A edits and rejecting dirty-state and frame/copy mutations.
scope_change_reason: PR1868 supplies two non-restored helper-prefix instances and explicitly leaves native 5/9/11-stage replay open. Audit that exact handoff, complementary to the active symbolic-contract audit.
bottleneck_link: Tests a missing finite execution obligation of a replacement helper interface; paid profile is unchanged and the complex side still binds. No new kappa or supplier adoption.
stop_rule: One bounded replay of four pinned words and targeted controls; stop on any native mismatch and report exact failure. Do not extend synthesis or modify selected artifacts.
evidence: RESULT.json: four complete native legality checks and twelve 5/9/11-stage F2 all-column replays; separate Python candidate reconstruction, exact record bytes, dirty boundaries and positive bounds; 192 inherited omitted-bridge controls and 18 additional controls. Scope excludes physical frame transport, hosting and supplier adoption.
author: Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in implementation, checking and writing; one agent, no independent human review.

open_questions.question: Can an absorbed word pass a complete hosted-supplier invoice under an accepted twisted interface?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Native finite checks are only one missing obligation before supplier adoption.
open_questions.first_step: Bind a passing native receipt and exact candidate to the hosted emitter and independent owner/invoice audit.
open_questions.blocked_by: Maintainer acceptance of the helper climb/cleanup contract and complete hosted execution.

overlap.limitation: Titles/bodies, comments, top-level local notes and ledger; not all diffs.

final_overlap.limits: Remote PR scope is open PRs including drafts. Closed work is searched through local READMEs, TASK metadata and ledger only. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.

reviewed_overlaps.scope: Independent symbolic contract audit; complementary, no native replay.
